notes.title: Woops
notes.notes:
Sorry again for all the game issues thank you for joining the discord and reporting bugs so I can get em fixed quickly.

Fixed the Item shop so all players can now use it in multiplayer.

Fixed Abilities so all players can now use them.

Fixed a bunch of other network replication stuff.

*NEXT PATCH*

Should hopefully have another patch out within a week with proper enemy AI. I just added some quick basic code to make then target nearest player. Next update enemies will properly follow/chase players, move around obstacles, have usable ablities etc.

After I finish the enemy AI system all core functions will be complete and I can start focusing on making and adding all the new content. You can see upcoming/WIP content for game in the discord.

Thanks again for helping me test and develop BattleTubers.

Be Goat To Each Other.

notes.title: Another quick patch
notes.notes:
How's it Goattin? Did another quick patch to fix a couple bugs.

Sorry again there's not much content atm. I need people to test and make sure Multiplayer, Twitch integration is working first otherwise I'll have to redo ALOT of content later on if I need to fix twitch stuff.

You can help development by joining the discord to report bugs etc. Can also see upcoming game content in there.


Edit: Just received more bug reports for issues like only the host being able to use the equipment shop. Working on fixing that and a couple other bugs now should have another patch out by tomorrow.

Please keep in mind this is a VERY early access game that I'm actively developing and adding content to. Goin as fast as I can but I'm a single goat working on this with no funding as a hobby. Very sorry it's still kinda scuffed.

The main reason for releasing it so early is because I need to make sure multiplayer and Twitch integration is functioning correctly in steams online subsystem. It would be incredibly difficult and cause more bugs long-term if I added a ton of content I'd have to go back and redo if Twitch functions didn't work correctly. Thank you for the patience.

People joining the discord to report bugs, ask game questions etc. has been tremendously helpful thank you again!

Have a Goat Day!

notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs and worked on twitch integration a bit so its faster. Added enemies that will only spawn if I'm in your Twitch channel watching while you have integration on. Stream under the BattleTubers category on Twitch to find me in your channels.

notes.title: BattleTubers First Content Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed the Twitch Integration system.

Added the ability to import your own .vrm models for single player.

New characters.

Added clickable links to each characters Twitch and BlueSky in character select screen.

You can now apply status effects to enemies like Burning, poison, slow etc.

Visit BodegaRat's Vtuber Merch Shop to spend points on buffs, new weapons, weapon upgrades.

You can now buy and equip Vtuber stickers and keychains to your weapon for increased stats and usable abilities.

There's more content and bug fixes that I can't remember right now.



Very sorry it was nearly a year before the first content update. Had a major harddrive issue and had to redo alot of work. 

I'm back to working on this game full time as well as another free game I just released called Southside Racing. Will do my goatical best to try and add content to both games as fast as I can make it!

Don't forget to join the discord if you want to help improve the game by reporting bugs or suggesting content.

Have a Goat Day.

notes.title: Multiplayer Twitch Integration
notes.notes: Made a new Twitch Integration options menu so players can enable/disable twitch events and set their own channel redeem costs.
